name: RoadBook
definition: RoadBook is BlackRoad's digital-native publishing and knowledge product. RoadBook is for books, audiobooks, research, essays, notes, articles, peer review, commentary, provenance, authorship, narration, reader/author collaboration, royalties, and source-backed knowledge. RoadBook exists because writing, narration, publishing, and research are trapped in bad marketplaces, bad economics, physical-book assumptions, and gatekeeping. It should make it easier for people to write, publish, narrate, review, sell, cite, and preserve text/audio knowledge without becoming just a PDF dump or trapping authors in bad royalty systems.
core_promise: Publish knowledge without losing ownership, proof, or voice.
